 Follow us on Facebook Twitter Hello Latest news The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has announced a recall of a popular plant-based butter affecting 10 states.
 Andrew Kelly Consumer Recall alert: FDA announces yeast, mold and E. Coli found in this product used daily in American homes
 Greg Heilman Update: Oct 28th, 2026 07:43 EDT 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has announced a recall of a popular plant-based butter that was distributed in 10 states. The Class II recall , meaning that it is unlikely to cause permanent health issues, but may cause temporary or reversible effects, was issued due to yeast, mold and E. Coli contamination. 
 The affected product is 8-ouce Miyoko’s Creamery European Style Salted Plant Milk Butter . According to the FDA notice, Prosperity Organic Foods, Inc. is voluntarily recalling 1,304 cases that were affected which were distributed in Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Iowa, Illinois, Indiana, Maryland, New Jersey, New Hampshire and Wisconsin. 
 Information customers should look for: 
 UPC: 857554005773 
 Lot number primary SBS packaging: 07871 
 Lot number secondary corrugate packaging: 1007871 
 Best by: 11/5/26 
 Miyoko’s Creamery If you have purchased this product, it is recommended not to consume it as it can result in E. Coli poisoning, or adverse reactions from the molds or yeast. You should dispose of it, cleaning and sanitizing any surfaces, containers, equipment, and utensils that have come into contact with it with hot soapy water following FDA guidelines .
